scope: complete current SQL constraint definitions and relationships for all public/private application tables
procedure: Read all complete live pg_get_constraintdef SQL texts in ordered disjoint batches, then independently retrieved one full current 261-row source/MD5/validation and supporting index readiness manifest. Directly interpreted key/ownership, composite FK and ON DELETE semantics, numerical/enum/JSON/status guards and circular DEFERRABLE links. SQL read-only, no member records.

semantic_findings: All 261 current application constraints are validated; all 60 PK/UNIQUE constraints have valid, ready supporting indexes.

Composite owner/setup/library/shot relationships remain structurally enforced; three intentionally deferred FKs support active setup, recipe favorite and setup version circular selection without unsafe immediate violation.

Public espresso numeric bounds/shot legacy exception, community quality/status invariants, signup review/status checks and private audit/deletion statuses remain enforced in complete current definitions.
Invite/action legacy check values and Bag data structures cannot be declared dead from provider shape: retain historical compatibility and await separately authorized release.
A validated constraint is not runtime Auth/RLS certification; no actual member data or post-release acceptance was tested.
limits: Provider-hosted Auth/JWT/PostgREST settings, compiled internals and disk headroom inaccessible/unverified.
Constraint definitions do not establish business-code caller reachability or prove all user data is free of bugs.
No new first-time provider-original word credit: prior structural intake exists; this is a new all-constraint current cross-object semantic pass.
